name: vscode-nonebot-locales-viewer
description: Supports displaying a preview of the multilingual support keys for nonebot-plugins-locales.

nonebotLocalesViewer.localeDirectory.markdownDescription: Path to the locale directory, relative to each workspace folder. Leave empty to detect a static `locales_init(...)` path automatically; `assets/lang` is used as a final fallback.

nonebotLocalesViewer.language.markdownDescription: Default selection for a locale directory. Missing locale files or keys display `NO TRANSLATION!!!`.

nonebotLocalesViewer.replyFunctions.markdownDescription: Function names whose first string argument is a localization key.

nonebotLocalesViewer.displayMode.markdownDescription: `inline` replaces the key visually; `after` keeps the key and appends its translation.

nonebotLocalesViewer.previewColor.markdownDescription: Optional CSS color for translated previews. Leave empty to use the active theme's string color.

commands.title: NoneBot2 Locales Viewer: Select preview language

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
